Hi Ellen / Maya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Short recap and concrete next steps so we can get the trial started next week. Per our discussion I split the plan into three staged evaluation gates so PayBridge can validate impact incrementally and we can limit scope of work up front.

Stage A — Ingest & baseline
- Goal: Validate API connectivity, latency, and end-to-end embedding lookups for a representative subset (5k rows).
- Success criteria: <100ms p50 for single-request generation (non-stream), embeddings similarity recall >= 0.82 on sample set, end-to-end roundtrip with your search layer under 250ms for cached prefixes.
- Timeline: 3 business days for initial connectivity + 2 days for baseline measurements.
- Owner: PayBridge infra + Redwood (SOFIA as AWS/VPC lead).

Stage B — Feature prototype (streaming + tool call)
- Goal: Demo streaming responses and a tool call flow that hits your transaction enrichment service.
- Success criteria: stable streaming sessions with <5% dropped frames, tool-call success rate >= 95% for enrichment endpoint during test window, and no PII leakage in generated content.
- Timeline: 4 business days after Stage A acceptance.
- Owner: PayBridge platform + Redwood (ENGINEERING lead: DEV).

Stage C — Scale & SLO validation
- Goal: Run a small production-like workload (sustained burst for 2 hours) to validate autoscaling and cost envelope.
- Success criteria: meet 95th percentile latency targets per agreed SLOs and cost per 1k tokens within quoted band.
- Timeline: 2 business days after Stage B acceptance.
- Owner: Joint (REDWOOD ops + PayBridge SRE).

Core trial delivery items we will produce:
- SDK quickstart for your engineers (node/python examples) — attached: redwood_sdk_quickstart.md
- Trial scope matrix with datasets & acceptance tests — attached: trial_scope_matrix.xlsx
- PO / trial terms doc for procurement — attached: po-trial-terms.pdf

Implementation notes (technical hits from the call):
- Primary API routes: POST /v1/generate for batch & sync generation, WebSocket endpoint wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream for streaming responses.
- Validation hooks: we will expose per-request tracing id and provide a sample trace collector to correlate with your APM.
- Tool calling: Redwood can invoke your enrichment service via a signed callback (HTTPS) — we'll provide a sample handler and recommended auth (mTLS or signed JWT).
- Data handling: request/response logs will be sampled and encrypted; we will not persist raw customer data beyond trial unless you opt-in.

Immediate next steps (action owners & due dates):
- PayBridge: Share a 5k-row sample dataset + API access for enrichment test (due: 2026-07-16) — Maya.
- Redwood (Sofia): Provision trial environment, produce SDK quickstart, and send CI instructions (due: 2026-07-16).
- Redwood (Marissa): Send draft trial Statement of Work and PO guidance to procurement (due: 2026-07-15).
- Engineering kickoff: schedule 30–45m technical onboarding with PayBridge platform (proposed: 2026-07-17) — owner: Dev.

I attached the quickstart and scope matrix. Please reply to confirm owners/timelines or flag any constraints we missed. Happy to adjust windows if procurement needs more time.

Best,
